reason: I'd probably poke at the free plan some evening, but I won't pay 99 euros a month until I see it actually answer my customer emails and post for me without me redoing everything. I already pay for ChatGPT and our CRM is a mess, so I doubt it would learn our business any better than what I have.
objection: I already pay for ChatGPT. What does this do that it doesn't, and will it really work off a CRM nobody updates, or will it just make me another tool to babysit at night?
would_change_my_mind: A demo with my own inbox and social accounts where it handles a week of customer emails and posts by itself and clearly saves me several hours, with the onboarding team doing the setup.
